# CodexMeter 1.4.10
A small polish on the menu bar diamond.
## What changed
- **The diamond's fill eases to a new level instead of snapping.** When the tightest account limit ticks down between refreshes, the diamond now drains toward the new level over about half a second rather than jumping. Reduce Motion still snaps.
No preference or data changes.
## Verification
- 297 automated tests, 0 failures (8 environment-integration tests skipped); `DiamondMeterIconTests` render the meter through `ImageRenderer` and check that a fuller diamond draws more ink. - `swift build` with zero warnings and zero errors. - Universal 2 build for Apple silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14 or later; the bundled Claude limits helper is signed and verified as part of the release. - The app remains ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized. SHA-256 protects the first download; Sparkle authenticates later update feeds and archives with Ed25519 signatures.
## Install or update with Homebrew
```bash brew update brew upgrade --cask --greedy dlfkdLR/tap/codexmeter ```
For a new installation:
```bash brew install --cask dlfkdLR/tap/codexmeter ```
If macOS blocks this certificate-free app after installation, confirm that it came from `dlfkdLR/tap/codexmeter`, then remove quarantine from this app only:
```bash xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
## First direct-download launch
Download `CodexMeter-1.4.10.dmg` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` from this release into the same folder. Verify the checksum before opening the disk image:
```bash cd ~/Downloads grep ' CodexMeter-1.4.10.dmg$' SHA256SUMS.txt | shasum -a 256 -c - open CodexMeter-1.4.10.dmg ```
Only after the checksum reports `OK`, copy `CodexMeter.app` to Applications and use the app-scoped quarantine command above.
## Recovery
This release does not migrate any database. Published version tags are immutable; corrections ship as a new patch release.
